text: Adagio, the European leader in aparthotels, was created in France in 2007 as a joint venture between Accor and Pierre & Vacances Center Parcs.
short: Adagio is a joint venture of Accor and Pierre & Vacances Center Parcs

source.name: FDJ-SUEZ — Adagio devient partenaire majeur de l'équipe FDJ-SUEZ (communiqué officiel)
source.quote: Créée en France en 2007 en tant que joint-venture entre Accor et Pierre & Vacances Center Parcs, Adagio compte aujourd’hui 130 sites
source.note: Translation: 'Created in France in 2007 as a joint venture between Accor and Pierre & Vacances Center Parcs, Adagio today has 130 sites' (from the communiqué's 'À propos d'Adagio' section).
